stage1Update.note: Stage 1 delivers real production runner, MariaDB/Redis probes, migration runner, schema fingerprint verifier, server process manager, adapter factory (production forbids stubs), scanner readiness derivation, authoritative status source, and graceful shutdown. Stage 1-FIX restores MariaDB as canonical engine, adds real server bootstrap endpoints, downgrades managed-Docker to contract_verified only, and adds a real external-services integration test that spawns the actual server. Existing capabilities whose maturity changes are annotated below.

changes.evidence: External-services integration test spawns the real server against local MariaDB + Redis and exercises: dependency-aware readiness, migrations through the desktop migration runner, real Create Order counters, real reconciliation state, derived scanner readiness, graceful shutdown, and restart. Managed_docker remains contract-only until a real Docker engine executes the stack.
MigrationRunner spawns real drizzle-kit via ChildProcessCommandRunner; the Stage 1-FIX external-services test runs it end-to-end against a fresh MariaDB database

docker-compose.prod.yml pins mariadb:10.11.6 and redis:7.4-alpine with server/db/redis healthchecks; localhost binding; volumes renamed mariadb_data. Runtime not verified in this stage (no Docker available in the audit container).

DesktopStatusSource reads authoritative values from /api/desktop/create-order-counters, /api/desktop/observer-policy-versions, /api/desktop/champion-configuration on the real running server. Unknown source yields known=false rather than misleading zeros.

ServerAdapter uses /api/system/readiness (dependency-aware). ServerProcessManager parses the readiness body and treats ready=false as not_ready even when HTTP is 200. 7 tests in stage1fix_readiness_semantics.test.ts exercise every failure component.

apps/server/src/routes/desktop.ts: /api/system/readiness, /api/desktop/create-order-counters, /api/desktop/observer-policy-versions, /api/desktop/champion-configuration, /api/desktop/scanner-readiness, /api/desktop/reconciliation/status. Localhost-only. External test proves the desktop reads real values from a running server.
